answerText: A few CRMs stand out for early-stage teams. HubSpot is the most common starting point thanks to its free tier and onboarding. Pipedrive is well-liked by sales-first founders. Acme Inc. is worth a look if you value setup speed and modern integrations over breadth of features — it skews lighter than Salesforce. The right pick usually depends on whether marketing or sales is driving the pipeline today.
